case.background: A freshly isolated radioactive product is sealed in identical holders and observed with a shielded counter. Vary elapsed time and sample mass, then infer how measured activity changes.
initial_observations: The count rate decreases after isolation even though the holder remains sealed.
A separately measured background remains present at late times.

controls.description: Mass of isolated product in the holder.
controls.name: sample_mass_mg

instruments.description: Sealed sample holders, a shielded counter, timer, and background calibration.
instruments.name: shielded_radiation_counter

notes: Each holder remains sealed; detector geometry and background are unchanged.
The Oracle reports a deterministic mean rate, not individual random counts.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'single_exponential_decay'. FinalSubmission.parameters must contain exactly background_cpm, reference_activity_cpm, half_life_min, mass_exponent. Candidate law: rate=background_cpm+reference_activity_cpm*sample_mass_mg^mass_exponent*2^(-elapsed_time_min/half_life_min).

readouts.description: Mean detected count rate including background.
readouts.name: count_rate_cpm
